comments.mellificent: Promising for previous yard but pulled up for new stable back from another layoff
comments.parisianfashion: Irish point winner; good start to hurdle career; has more to come now handicapping
comments.santaclarita: Two good efforts at about 2m5f in midwinter but pulled up on last two starts; 6lb wrong
comments.sundaysoldier: Latest win last April; down the field latest; prefers good to soft/soft; now tongue tied

verdict.comment: There's little to choose between PROTEST RALLY and Sacred Falls on recent C&D running, with the former just shading it.

comments.daytonalady: Has done most winning on the AW and never off a mark this high; held on her comeback here
comments.dreamdeal: Hasn't been seen since last August and goes without the usual headgear for his new yard
comments.mojomaker: Regressive but holds claims on his recent third, under Rossa Ryan from the inside stall
comments.protestrally: Solid C&D comeback two weeks ago; his claims are obvious back in the usual cheekpieces
comments.quercus: Five-time C&D winner who's never achieved a lot on comeback; entitled to need this
comments.runningcool: Resumes another 5lb lower but would want to see some support before considering him
comments.sacredfalls: Favourite for a similar handicap on her C&D comeback a fortnight ago; is one to consider
comments.soulseeker: High enough in the weights for his new yard and might just need this at his age
comments.twelfthknight: Tumbled down the weights last year before undergoing wind surgery; worth keeping an eye on

comments.palazzopersico: Ready win off this mark at Chelmsford in December; some good runs since; visor back today

comments.visibility: Yet to win on Polytrack but he comes here in good form and has run well over C&D before
comments.yarborough: Promise in three handicap runs last year; absent ten months but still has low mileage
